listing.name: Champions of Norrath — halogen (0xjjjjjj)
listing.summary: Upstream reports engine startup and the main menu, but lumpFind menu-asset defects block actual game output. Replaying a PCSX2 town dump does not establish gameplay rendered by this port. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS-20565 disc and extracted ELF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate code locally on Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64, apply upstream’s required patches after regeneration, then build halogen-headless with CMake. Live Vulkan presentation is planned.

warnings: Upstream reports engine startup and the main menu, but lumpFind menu-asset defects block actual game output. Replaying a PCSX2 town dump does not establish gameplay rendered by this port.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
